crypto_keylength_justification: The complete supported --no-llm configuration performs GitHub scanning and all normal report generation without Anthropic construction/network access. Exact verified-chain checks enforce RSA >=2048 bits and EC >=224 bits including trust anchors before credentials; TLS1.2/1.3 negative tests cover weak leaves/intermediates/roots. Built-in HTML embeds locked Plotly instead of fetching a CDN. Publication/release helpers use the separately verified gh/Go fips140 profile. Optional LLM transport is outside this strict configuration. https://github.com/4alvit/iot-project-builder-profile/blob/main/docs/SUPPORTED_PROFILE.md https://github.com/4alvit/iot-project-builder-profile/blob/main/docs/tls-policy.md https://github.com/4alvit/iot-project-builder-profile/blob/main/docs/RELEASE_TLS_PROFILE.md
crypto_working_justification: No intentionally broken cipher/hash algorithm is enabled for security. Application HTTPS retains ordinary certificate verification and current maintained crypto implementations. The supported strict profile additionally enforces exact key size; it does not assert all optional algorithm settings. https://github.com/4alvit/iot-project-builder-profile/blob/main/docs/SUPPORTED_PROFILE.md
crypto_weaknesses_justification: The strict GitHub/gh profile is verified, but every optional Anthropic transport and custom endpoint configuration has not been independently established under this stronger universal criterion. https://github.com/4alvit/iot-project-builder-profile/blob/main/docs/quality.md

crypto_password_storage_justification: There is no external-user password verifier database.
